[[Miki's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] dropped by [[Miki the Skull Spirit]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Haiju Lagoon]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +5
:[[Lightning damage|Lightning Dmg]]: 8-13 (Requires 5 [[Channeling Magic]])
:[[HCT|Halves casting time]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 5%)
:[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of spells (Chance: 10%)
:[[Health]] +10
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] +5

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Channeling Staff]].

==Replica==
It is possible to create a [[perfect]] technical version for this item with:
*[[Channeling Staff]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], or [[Soros]]
*[[Perfect]] "Don't Think Twice" [[inscription]]
*One of the following combinations of mods:
**[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]] AND [[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Defense]]
**[[Perfect]] [[Defensive]] [[Staff Head]] AND [[Perfect]] [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]]
